# Revenue management software built for European finance teams

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en
- **Title**: MYFUNDBOX | EU Revenue Management & IFRS 15 Software
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

MYFUNDBOX is EU-based revenue management software engineered in Germany for CFOs, financial controllers, and RevOps teams. It tracks, recognizes, forecasts, and reconciles recurring revenue under IFRS 15 and German HGB/GoBD—connecting to existing billing and ERP tools without processing payments or issuing customer invoices.

## At a Glance
- **What it is**: Standalone EU revenue management software (sub-ledger, recognition, analytics & forecasting). Not a payment gateway or billing engine.
- **Who it is for**: CFOs, controllers, accountants, and RevOps teams at European SaaS, digital services, membership, and agency businesses.
- **Key capabilities**: IFRS 15 & HGB revenue recognition rules; Deferred revenue & accrual roll-forwards; MRR, ARR, NRR, churn & cohort reporting; Contract-level revenue forecasting & audit trail
- **Pricing model**: [ADD: Tiered EUR plans / Custom quote based on annual recurring revenue]
- **Region & compliance**: Built in Germany · GDPR-compliant · EU data residency [CONFIRM Frankfurt] · EU VAT separation
- **Integrations**: DATEV, SAP, Xero, Exact, NetSuite, Stripe Billing, Chargebee, HubSpot, Salesforce, REST API [CONFIRM list]

## What is MYFUNDBOX and why does spreadsheet revenue tracking break?

MYFUNDBOX replaces manual spreadsheet revenue waterfalls with an automated, audit-ready revenue sub-ledger. As subscription businesses add annual prepayments, mid-term upgrades, credit notes, and SEPA enterprise invoices across multiple tools, Excel models introduce cutoff errors and slow month-end close.

- Eliminates manual pro-rata date formulas and broken spreadsheet VLOOKUPs across billing exports.
- Separates gross cash collected (including EU VAT) from net recognized revenue and deferred liability.
- Maintains an immutable, user-attributed audit trail ready for IFRS 15 and HGB/GoBD statutory reviews.

## How does MYFUNDBOX automate revenue management in 3 steps?

MYFUNDBOX ingests contract and invoice events from your billing, CRM, and ERP systems, applies deterministic IFRS 15 recognition rules in EUR, and exports clean period-close journals and live executive forecasts.

1. **Connect billing, CRM, and ERP data sources**: Sync subscriptions, enterprise contracts, credit notes, and FX rates in read-only mode via native connectors or the REST API.
2. **Apply IFRS 15 & HGB recognition rules automatically**: Assign performance obligations, daily or monthly straight-line schedules, and accrual cutoffs without altering customer invoicing.
3. **Close the month and publish board-ready forecasts**: Export balanced deferred-to-recognized journals (DATEV / ERP) alongside unified MRR, ARR, NRR, and cash vs. revenue projections.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is MYFUNDBOX a payment processor or billing system?
No. MYFUNDBOX never processes card or SEPA payments and does not replace your billing/invoicing engine. It sits above your billing and CRM tools as a dedicated revenue accounting, analytics, and forecasting sub-ledger.

### Does MYFUNDBOX support IFRS 15 and German HGB/GoBD?
Yes. Recognition schedules follow IFRS 15 performance-obligation principles and support German HGB period-end accrual structures with immutable audit logs [CONFIRM external GoBD attestation status].

### Where is customer financial data hosted?
MYFUNDBOX operates with EU-first GDPR compliance and EU data residency [CONFIRM: Frankfurt am Main, Germany]. No third-party trackers load before explicit cookie consent.

### How does MYFUNDBOX handle EU VAT in revenue reports?
EU VAT (USt/TVA) is stripped from gross invoiced totals before calculating recognized revenue, deferred revenue liabilities, MRR, and ARR.

### Which accounting and ERP systems can receive exports?
MYFUNDBOX supports structured journal exports and connectors for European and global ERPs including DATEV, SAP, Exact, Xero, and NetSuite [CONFIRM exact active connectors].

### What currency and date formats are used by default?
EUR is the default reporting currency alongside European date and number formatting, with multi-currency contract conversion supported.

# Automated IFRS 15 revenue recognition software for European finance teams

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/product/revenue-recognition
- **Title**: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition Software | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

MYFUNDBOX Revenue Recognition translates raw subscription, contract, and credit note events into IFRS 15 and HGB-compliant recognition schedules. Finance controllers configure rule-based performance obligations once and generate immutable monthly journal entries without manual spreadsheet waterfalls.

## At a Glance
- **What it is**: Rule-based IFRS 15 & HGB revenue recognition engine built for recurring and contract-based businesses.
- **Who it is for**: Controllers, Chief Accountants, and CFOs preparing monthly closes and annual statutory audits.
- **Key capabilities**: Daily exact-day and monthly straight-line recognition; Performance obligation bundling & standalone selling price (SSP) splits; Mid-term contract upgrades, downgrades, pauses & credit notes; Immutable audit trail linked to source invoice IDs
- **Pricing model**: Included in MYFUNDBOX platform plans [ADD: Tier pricing]
- **Region & compliance**: IFRS 15 · German HGB · GoBD-aligned immutability · EU VAT separation
- **Integrations**: DATEV, SAP, Xero, Exact, NetSuite, Stripe Billing, Chargebee, HubSpot, Salesforce

## How does MYFUNDBOX handle the 5-step IFRS 15 model?

MYFUNDBOX operationalizes the five-step IFRS 15 framework by linking CRM deal terms and billing line items to standardized performance obligations, transaction prices net of EU VAT, and automated over-time or point-in-time recognition schedules.

| IFRS 15 Step | Accounting Requirement | How MYFUNDBOX Automates It |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Identify Contract | Approve commercial terms and collectability | Ingests signed CRM/ERP contract and subscription records with effective dates |
| 2. Performance Obligations | Separate distinct SaaS, onboarding, and support services | Maps SKU and line-item rules to distinct recognition templates |
| 3. Transaction Price | Determine consideration net of discounts and VAT | Strips EU VAT, applies credit notes, and isolates net consideration in EUR |
| 4. Allocate Price | Distribute transaction price across obligations | Applies configurable SSP allocation rules across bundled line items |
| 5. Recognize Revenue | Recognize as obligations are satisfied over time or point-in-time | Generates daily/monthly pro-rata schedules and period-close GL journals |

## How are contract modifications and cancellations processed?

When a customer upgrades seats, switches from monthly to annual billing, or receives a partial credit note, MYFUNDBOX recalculates remaining unrecognized revenue prospectively or via catch-up adjustment while preserving locked historical periods.

- Closed accounting periods remain strictly locked to protect GoBD and statutory audit integrity.
- Prospective adjustments flow transparently into future months without retroactively rewriting past trial balances.
- Every rule override requires role-based permission and records user ID, timestamp, and reason code.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can MYFUNDBOX split onboarding fees from recurring SaaS subscriptions?
Yes. Distinct line items can follow separate recognition schedules—for example, recognizing implementation milestones upon delivery while amortizing the software subscription straight-line over 12 months.

### Does MYFUNDBOX support daily exact-day proration as well as monthly?
Yes. Controllers can select exact daily proration (e.g., 28/30/31-day or 365-day conventions) or standard 1/12th monthly recognition per entity policy.

### How does the system protect closed months during an audit?
Once a period is closed in MYFUNDBOX, journal entries are locked; any subsequent invoice backdating posts as a documented adjustment in the current open period.

### Does MYFUNDBOX generate customer invoices?
No. MYFUNDBOX reads invoice data from your billing or ERP system and never sends invoices or processes customer payments.

### Is US GAAP ASC 606 supported for EU subsidiaries with US parents?
Yes. The underlying five-step contract and performance obligation framework aligns closely with both IFRS 15 and ASC 606 reporting needs.

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/product/revenue-reporting

- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

MYFUNDBOX Revenue Reporting unifies board-level SaaS KPIs—MRR, ARR, Net Revenue Retention, churn, and cohorts—with your GAAP/IFRS recognized revenue sub-ledger. Unlike standalone dashboard tools, every movement traces down to verified invoices, contract dates, and net-of-VAT amounts.

## At a Glance
- **What it is**: Finance-grade recurring revenue analytics bridging RevOps KPIs and statutory accounting.
- **Who it is for**: CFOs, FP&A leads, RevOps managers, and board-reporting finance teams.
- **Key capabilities**: MRR & ARR waterfall bridges (New, Expansion, Contraction, Churn); Gross and Net Revenue Retention (GRR / NRR) by cohort; Billings vs. Bookings vs. Recognized Revenue reconciliation; Role-based board and investor CSV/PDF/API exports
- **Pricing model**: Included in MYFUNDBOX plans [ADD: Tier details]
- **Region & compliance**: EUR default · European number/date conventions · EU VAT excluded from MRR/ARR
- **Integrations**: HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe Billing, Chargebee, ERP invoice feeds

## Why do RevOps MRR dashboards often disagree with Accounting revenue?

CRM and payment-gateway dashboards frequently mix gross invoiced amounts (including VAT), one-time setup fees, and cash collection dates with recurring run-rate. MYFUNDBOX normalizes contracts cleanly so RevOps and Controllers report from one reconciled definition.

- Excludes one-time implementation fees and EU VAT from MRR/ARR calculations automatically.
- Links every MRR bridge movement directly to customer IDs and underlying contract modifications.
- Provides side-by-side reconciliation between Bookings, Billings, Cash Collected, and IFRS 15 Recognized Revenue.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Which recurring revenue metrics are tracked natively?
MYFUNDBOX tracks MRR, ARR, New Business, Expansion, Contraction, Logo Churn, Revenue Churn, GRR, NRR, ARPA, and time-based cohort retention.

### Can we segment cohorts by customer tier, country, or sales channel?
Yes. Dimensions synced from your CRM or ERP (region, plan, segment, billing cadence) filter all waterfalls and cohort tables.

### Are one-time fees excluded from MRR and ARR?
Yes. Non-recurring implementation or setup items are categorized separately from recurring subscription MRR/ARR.

### Can stakeholders view read-only dashboards without editing accounting rules?
Yes. Role-based permissions separate controller/admin rule-editing rights from executive and RevOps read-only analytics access.

### Does MYFUNDBOX replace our payment gateway analytics?
It consolidates recurring revenue across all payment gateways and manual SEPA/ERP invoices into one finance-approved view.

# Revenue forecasting grounded in contracted schedules and cohort retention

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/product/revenue-forecasting
- **Title**: SaaS & Subscription Revenue Forecasting Software | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

MYFUNDBOX Revenue Forecasting projects future recognized revenue, deferred revenue burn-down, and renewal cash inflows directly from active customer contracts. Finance teams model conservative, base, and expansion scenarios without rebuilding fragile multi-tab spreadsheet forecasts every month.

## At a Glance
- **What it is**: Contract-driven recognized revenue and recurring renewal forecasting engine.
- **Who it is for**: CFOs, FP&A managers, and finance leaders running rolling 12–36 month plans.
- **Key capabilities**: Contracted backlog & deferred revenue burn-down projections; Renewal, churn, and expansion scenario assumptions; Actuals vs. forecast variance tracking by month; Separation of contracted committed revenue vs. pipeline upside
- **Pricing model**: Included / Add-on module [ADD: tier specification]
- **Region & compliance**: EUR consolidated forecasting · EU multi-entity support [CONFIRM]
- **Integrations**: CRM pipeline (HubSpot/Salesforce) + live sub-ledger schedules

## How is revenue forecasting different from cash flow forecasting?

Cash flow forecasting estimates when invoices are paid in the bank, whereas revenue forecasting projects when contracted obligations become earned P&L revenue under IFRS 15. MYFUNDBOX separates committed deferred burn-down from renewal and new-business assumptions.

1. **Lock committed backlog from deferred revenue**: Automatically project guaranteed future recognition from signed, non-cancellable contracts already in your sub-ledger.
2. **Layer empirical cohort retention and expansion**: Apply historical GRR/NRR benchmarks or custom renewal probabilities to upcoming contract end dates.
3. **Compare forecast vs. actual close monthly**: Track P&L variance between prior forecast snapshots and actual closed IFRS 15 recognized revenue.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does MYFUNDBOX separate committed revenue from projected renewals?
Yes. Forecasts clearly distinguish locked contracted backlog from assumption-based renewals and CRM pipeline scenarios.

### Can we run sensitivity scenarios for churn or annual billing mix?
Yes. Finance teams can adjust churn, expansion, and annual-prepaid mix drivers to compare upside and downside P&L cases.

### How far ahead can MYFUNDBOX project deferred revenue burn-down?
Schedules project across the full remaining life of active contracts (12, 24, or 36+ months).

### Are forecast snapshots archived for board comparisons?
Yes. Monthly forecast baselines can be saved to compare actual close performance against prior budget versions.

### Can forecast tables be exported for FP&A consolidation?
Yes, monthly P&L and balance-sheet roll-forward projections export cleanly to CSV/Excel or via API.

# Automated deferred revenue schedules and period-end accruals

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/product/deferred-revenue-accruals
- **Title**: Deferred Revenue & Accruals Automation Software | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

MYFUNDBOX automates deferred revenue (passive Rechnungsabgrenzungsposten / PRAP) and accrued unbilled revenue schedules at customer and contract level. Controllers eliminate manual month-end cutoff spreadsheets and reconcile opening-to-closing balance sheet movements down to every individual invoice.

## At a Glance
- **What it is**: Sub-ledger engine for deferred revenue liabilities, contract assets, and monthly accruals.
- **Who it is for**: Financial controllers, senior accountants, and external auditors.
- **Key capabilities**: Opening + Billings - Recognized = Closing roll-forward reports; Short-term (<12m) vs. long-term (>12m) deferred split; Unbilled revenue (accrued assets) when delivery precedes invoicing; Customer-level balance sheet tie-out for year-end audits
- **Pricing model**: Included in core MYFUNDBOX platform [ADD: tier details]
- **Region & compliance**: IFRS 15 contract liabilities/assets · German HGB PRAP/ARAP · DATEV-ready structure
- **Integrations**: DATEV, SAP, Exact, Xero, NetSuite, Stripe Billing, Chargebee

## How does the deferred revenue roll-forward tie out to your balance sheet?

Every euro billed in advance enters the deferred revenue liability account (net of VAT) and amortizes cleanly into recognized revenue over the service period. MYFUNDBOX generates an auditable waterfall connecting opening balance, new billings, adjustments, recognized revenue, and ending balance.

- Separates current (≤12 months) and non-current (>12 months) deferred revenue for multi-year prepayments.
- Tracks accrued/unbilled receivables when service delivery starts before the billing run.
- Drill down from any general ledger balance directly to the underlying contracts and invoices.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does MYFUNDBOX distinguish short-term and long-term deferred revenue?
Yes. Multi-year prepaid contracts automatically split recognition schedules between current (<12 months) and non-current (>12 months) liabilities.

### What happens if a service begins before an invoice is issued?
MYFUNDBOX records accrued (unbilled) revenue for the delivered period and reverses it automatically once the invoice posts.

### How does this align with German HGB Rechnungsabgrenzungsposten (PRAP)?
Prepaid annual or multi-year fees collected before the balance-sheet date are systematically deferred across future periods in line with HGB accrual principles.

### Can auditors inspect individual contract schedules in read-only mode?
Yes. Role-based permissions allow external auditors or tax advisors read-only access to schedules and audit logs.

### How are credit notes handled in deferred revenue?
Credit notes reduce remaining unrecognized deferred revenue or post documented catch-up reversals depending on your policy configuration.

# Revenue recognition and analytics for digital services and media

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/solutions/digital-services
- **Title**: Revenue Management for Digital Services & Media | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

Digital publishers, software marketplaces, and media platforms rely on MYFUNDBOX to amortize prepaid annual passes, isolate cross-border EU VAT rates before recognizing revenue, and track subscriber cohort retention across European markets without touching checkout or payment processing.

## Why is EU VAT separation critical in digital media revenue reporting?

Digital services sold across EU member states carry varying local VAT rates (OSS/MOSS). Reporting gross checkout totals as MRR distorts unit economics and violates IFRS 15; MYFUNDBOX isolates net revenue per jurisdiction automatically.

- Tracks high-volume consumer and prosumer prepaid subscriptions without slowing down close.
- Separates promotional discount periods and partial refunds cleanly.
- Forecasts renewal cohorts by acquisition period and billing cadence.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does MYFUNDBOX strip varying EU VAT rates automatically?
Yes. Tax amounts on ingested invoices are mapped to VAT liability accounts so recognized revenue and MRR always reflect net consideration.

### Can it handle high-volume annual digital passes?
Yes. Prepaid annual subscriptions amortize automatically over 12 months with consolidated monthly GL journal summaries.

### Does MYFUNDBOX replace our paywall or payment gateway?
No. You keep your existing paywall, app store, or payment provider and feed finalized billing events into MYFUNDBOX.

### How are refunds and chargebacks reflected?
Refunds and credit notes adjust deferred liabilities or recognized periods cleanly with full audit linkage.

### Can media teams forecast subscription renewals?
Yes, cohort retention models project expected renewal revenue across monthly and annual subscriber groups.

# Deferred revenue and retention clarity for membership organizations

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/solutions/memberships
- **Title**: Deferred Revenue Software for Memberships & Associations | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

Membership organizations, B2B networks, and professional associations collect annual dues upfront while delivering member benefits over twelve months. MYFUNDBOX automates straight-line dues recognition, tracks deferred liabilities cleanly for year-end audits, and forecasts member renewal retention.

## How should annual membership dues be recognized?

Under IFRS 15 and European accrual accounting (HGB), annual membership fees collected upfront represent deferred revenue (a liability) on day one and must be recognized proportionally across the twelve-month membership term.

- Separates recurring membership dues from point-in-time event tickets or sponsorships.
- Eliminates year-end audit scrambling over active vs. expired member periods.
- Provides clear renewal rate and cohort retention tracking by member tier.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can MYFUNDBOX separate annual dues from one-off conference fees?
Yes. Dues amortize over the membership term while event fees recognize on the event delivery date.

### What if members join mid-month?
Daily proration options recognize exact service days in the joining and expiring months.

### Does MYFUNDBOX collect membership payments?
No. It connects to your existing membership or billing platform purely for revenue accounting and forecasting.

### Is it compliant with German HGB accrual rules?
Yes, automated PRAP schedules align with period-accurate accrual accounting.

### Can finance committees view renewal forecasts?
Yes, read-only forecast and retention dashboards export cleanly for board and committee reviews.

Zuora Revenue is an enterprise-grade revenue recognition engine built primarily for large global corporations running multi-product quote-to-cash ecosystems. MYFUNDBOX focuses on European finance teams that need IFRS 15, HGB/GoBD, and recurring revenue forecasting without multi-quarter enterprise ERP implementation cycles.

## Migration Steps
1. Export historical contract schedules, open deferred revenue balances, and active performance obligations as of your cutoff period.
2. Connect your upstream billing and CRM data sources to MYFUNDBOX via native connectors or API.
3. Map general ledger revenue, deferred revenue, and EU VAT accounts to match your chart of accounts.
4. Run a parallel month-end close reconciliation comparing opening deferred balances before locking the live period.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is MYFUNDBOX a replacement for Zuora Billing?
No. MYFUNDBOX is revenue management software, not a billing engine or payment gateway. It compares directly with Zuora Revenue by ingesting data from your existing billing tools.

### How does MYFUNDBOX differ from Zuora Revenue for German companies?
MYFUNDBOX is engineered in Germany with EU data residency, EUR defaults, EU VAT separation, and HGB/GoBD-aligned audit trails built for European controllers.

### Can we migrate open deferred revenue balances from Zuora to MYFUNDBOX?
Yes. During onboarding, opening deferred revenue balances and active contract schedules are imported at a clean cutoff date and reconciled before going live.

### Does MYFUNDBOX charge a percentage of payment volume?
No. Because MYFUNDBOX does not process payments, pricing is never tied to payment gateway transaction fees [ADD: confirm exact billing tier basis].

### Which platform is better for a 3-person finance team?
MYFUNDBOX is built so lean CFO and controller teams can configure recognition rules and close books without a full-time systems administrator.

# MYFUNDBOX vs Chargebee RevRec: Revenue Management Comparison

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/compare/myfundbox-vs-chargebee-revrec
- **Title**: MYFUNDBOX vs Chargebee RevRec (2026) | Comparison
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

Chargebee RevRec (formerly RevLock) is a revenue recognition product closely aligned with the Chargebee subscription billing ecosystem and US/global ASC 606 workflows. MYFUNDBOX is a standalone, billing-agnostic EU revenue management platform built in Germany for IFRS 15, HGB/GoBD accounting workflows, and integrated SaaS revenue forecasting.

*Last reviewed: 2026-11-18. Information about third-party software is compiled from publicly available documentation and vendor pages as of the review date shown. Features, pricing models, and compliance certifications may change; confirm current specifications directly with each vendor.*

## Feature Comparison
| Capability | MYFUNDBOX | Chargebee RevRec |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Independence from Billing Vendor | 100% billing-agnostic across sources | Tightly aligned with Chargebee ecosystem |
| EU Residency & German HGB/GoBD Focus | Built in Germany; EU-first compliance | Global SaaS compliance focus |
| IFRS 15 Recognition & Waterfalls | Core capability with full audit trail | Core capability (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) |
| Revenue Forecasting & Scenario Planning | Integrated contract & cohort forecasting | Primarily focused on historical & scheduled rec |
| MRR / ARR / NRR / Cohort Reporting | Unified with recognized ledger | Requires Chargebee Billing / Metrics pairing |
| Payment Processing Role | None (pure revenue management) | Part of Chargebee billing/payment suite |

## Migration Steps
1. Keep Chargebee Billing running if you use it for invoicing—MYFUNDBOX does not replace your billing engine.
2. Connect your billing source and CRM contract data into MYFUNDBOX in read-only mode.
3. Configure IFRS 15 / HGB recognition rules and reconcile one historical period against your existing waterfall.
4. Enable automated monthly journal exports to your EU accounting or ERP system.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I have to leave Chargebee Billing to use MYFUNDBOX?
No. MYFUNDBOX is not a billing engine. You can continue invoicing in Chargebee or any other billing system while managing revenue recognition and forecasting in MYFUNDBOX.

### How does MYFUNDBOX compare to Chargebee RevRec on forecasting?
MYFUNDBOX combines backward-looking IFRS 15 revenue recognition with forward-looking contract backlog and cohort revenue forecasting in one workspace.

### Does Chargebee RevRec support German HGB and DATEV?
Chargebee RevRec focuses primarily on ASC 606 and IFRS 15 journal exports for global ERPs; MYFUNDBOX is designed specifically around European compliance and accounting exports [CONFIRM exact DATEV spec].

### Can MYFUNDBOX consolidate revenue from both Chargebee and custom enterprise invoices?
Yes. Multi-source ingestion allows self-serve subscriptions and sales-led enterprise PDFs/ERP invoices to flow into one unified revenue sub-ledger.

### Which option avoids billing vendor lock-in?
MYFUNDBOX keeps your revenue sub-ledger independent from your billing and payment providers, making future billing changes non-disruptive to audit history.

# MYFUNDBOX vs Maxio: Revenue Management Comparison

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/compare/myfundbox-vs-maxio
- **Title**: MYFUNDBOX vs Maxio (2026) | Comparison
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

Maxio (formed from Chargify and SaaSOptics) combines B2B subscription billing, SaaS metrics, and GAAP revenue recognition primarily for North American B2B SaaS companies. MYFUNDBOX focuses strictly on pure-play EU revenue management—delivering IFRS 15, HGB/GoBD alignment, and European data residency without bundling billing.

*Last reviewed: 2026-11-18. Information about third-party software is compiled from publicly available documentation and vendor pages as of the review date shown. Features, pricing models, and compliance certifications may change; confirm current specifications directly with each vendor.*

## Feature Comparison
| Capability | MYFUNDBOX | Maxio |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Geographic & Regulatory Center of Gravity | EU / Germany (IFRS 15, HGB, GDPR) | US-first (ASC 606, GAAP) |
| Billing Engine Included | No (non-intrusive overlay) | Yes (Chargify billing heritage) |
| MRR / ARR / Churn / Expansion Bridges | Included in EUR & multi-currency | Included (SaaSOptics heritage) |
| Deferred Revenue & Accruals | Automated schedules & roll-forwards | Automated schedules & waterfalls |
| EU VAT Separation in Revenue Reports | Native net revenue vs. VAT handling | Requires tax/ERP configuration |
| Data Residency | EU-based hosting [CONFIRM Frankfurt] | US / multi-region hosting |

## Migration Steps
1. Export active contract and ARR bridge schedules from your existing metrics or billing tool.
2. Connect CRM and billing feeds into MYFUNDBOX without altering customer invoicing.
3. Validate IFRS 15 recognition mappings and reconcile MRR/ARR definitions.
4. Publish board-ready ARR bridges and period-close journal entries from MYFUNDBOX.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does MYFUNDBOX replace Chargify/Maxio billing?
No. MYFUNDBOX never issues invoices or processes payments; it serves as your revenue recognition, analytics, and forecasting layer.

### Why do European SaaS CFOs choose MYFUNDBOX over US-first tools like Maxio?
EU data residency, GDPR alignment, native EUR reporting, EU VAT separation, and IFRS 15 / German HGB compliance reduce friction with European auditors.

### Can MYFUNDBOX generate SaaSOptics-style ARR bridges and cohorts?
Yes. MYFUNDBOX tracks New, Expansion, Contraction, Churn, and Net Revenue Retention alongside recognized revenue.

### How does audit trail documentation work?
Every recognition adjustment, contract modification, and period close entry is logged with user attribution and timestamps.

### Can MYFUNDBOX handle multi-currency contracts alongside EUR?
Yes, multi-currency contracts are supported with EUR consolidated reporting [CONFIRM FX rate source].

# MYFUNDBOX vs Stripe Revenue Recognition: Revenue Management Comparison

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/compare/myfundbox-vs-stripe-revenue-recognition
- **Title**: MYFUNDBOX vs Stripe Revenue Recognition (2026) | Comparison
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

Stripe Revenue Recognition automates accrual accounting and deferred revenue waterfalls directly for transactions processed inside the Stripe ecosystem. MYFUNDBOX is a standalone, payment-agnostic European revenue management platform that unifies revenue across Stripe, bank transfers, ERP invoices, and multiple billing tools while adding forecasting and EU compliance.

*Last reviewed: 2026-11-18. Information about third-party software is compiled from publicly available documentation and vendor pages as of the review date shown. Features, pricing models, and compliance certifications may change; confirm current specifications directly with each vendor.*

## Feature Comparison
| Capability | MYFUNDBOX | Stripe Revenue Recognition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Multi-Source / Non-Stripe Revenue (SEPA, ERP, CRM) | Native multi-source ingestion | Primarily Stripe transactions (manual CSV import for external) |
| Payment Gateway Lock-in | None (works with any PSP or bank) | Built around Stripe ecosystem |
| Revenue Forecasting & Scenario Modeling | Dedicated forecasting engine | Historical & scheduled recognition only |
| EU Compliance (HGB / GoBD / DATEV) | EU-first accounting structure | General global accrual templates |
| MRR / ARR / NRR & Executive Dashboards | Full CFO & RevOps analytics suite | Basic SaaS metrics via Stripe Billing |
| Pricing Scaling | Fixed/tiered SaaS model [ADD: model] | Percentage of processed volume / custom |

## Migration Steps
1. Connect your Stripe account in read-only mode alongside your CRM or ERP invoice feed.
2. Import historical open annual contracts and non-Stripe wire-transfer agreements.
3. Verify deferred revenue balances match your prior Stripe waterfall at cutoff.
4. Run unified month-end close across all payment channels in MYFUNDBOX.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can MYFUNDBOX ingest Stripe Billing data automatically?
Yes. MYFUNDBOX reads subscription, invoice, credit note, and refund events from Stripe while remaining completely independent of payment processing.

### Why do companies outgrow Stripe Revenue Recognition?
Once B2B teams close enterprise deals via SEPA bank transfer, multi-year CRM contracts, or external invoicing, Stripe no longer sees 100% of revenue—creating manual spreadsheet gaps.

### Does MYFUNDBOX handle Stripe credit notes and partial refunds?
Yes. Credit notes, proration, and partial refunds adjust future recognition and deferred revenue schedules automatically with an audit trail.

### Is MYFUNDBOX a Stripe competitor for payments?
No. MYFUNDBOX does not process payments or act as a PSP. You keep Stripe (or Adyen, Mollie, GoCardless) for payments.

### Does MYFUNDBOX offer revenue forecasting beyond scheduled recognition?
Yes, MYFUNDBOX includes forward-looking revenue and retention forecasting beyond existing contracted schedules.

# MYFUNDBOX vs NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM): Revenue Management Comparison

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/compare/myfundbox-vs-netsuite-arm
- **Title**: MYFUNDBOX vs NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) (2026) | Comparison
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) embeds IFRS 15 and ASC 606 revenue rules directly inside the Oracle NetSuite ERP environment. MYFUNDBOX gives European finance teams a faster, dedicated revenue management layer that works with any accounting/ERP system—including DATEV, Exact, Xero, SAP, or NetSuite—while adding modern SaaS KPIs and forecasting.

*Last reviewed: 2026-11-18. Information about third-party software is compiled from publicly available documentation and vendor pages as of the review date shown. Features, pricing models, and compliance certifications may change; confirm current specifications directly with each vendor.*

## Feature Comparison
| Capability | MYFUNDBOX | NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ERP Lock-in | Works alongside DATEV, SAP, Xero, Exact, or NetSuite | Requires Oracle NetSuite ERP |
| IFRS 15 Performance Obligations | Rule-based sub-ledger schedules | NetSuite ARM rule engine |
| SaaS Metrics (MRR, ARR, NRR, Cohorts) | Built-in natively | Requires custom reports or SuiteApps |
| Revenue Forecasting | Built-in scenario & backlog forecasting | Limited outside NetSuite Planning/PBCS |
| Deployment Effort | Focused finance onboarding [ADD: timeline] | ERP + ARM consultant implementation |
| German HGB / DATEV Readiness | Built for European accounting stacks | Requires NetSuite DACH localization |

## Migration Steps
1. Connect your billing and CRM systems to MYFUNDBOX without touching your underlying general ledger vendor.
2. Map MYFUNDBOX revenue and deferred revenue accounts to your existing ERP chart of accounts.
3. Reconcile historical deferred balances and generate clean monthly summary or detail journal exports.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need to replace my accounting software to use MYFUNDBOX?
No. MYFUNDBOX acts as a specialized revenue sub-ledger that exports clean journal entries into DATEV, SAP, Xero, Exact, or NetSuite.

### Can MYFUNDBOX work alongside NetSuite?
Yes. Some finance teams use MYFUNDBOX to normalize multi-source SaaS contracts, calculate MRR/ARR cohorts, and feed summarized IFRS 15 journals into NetSuite.

### Does NetSuite ARM include MRR, NRR, and churn dashboards out of the box?
NetSuite ARM focuses on general-ledger accounting schedules; SaaS operational metrics typically require separate SuiteApps or BI tools, whereas MYFUNDBOX includes both.

### Is MYFUNDBOX suitable for German GmbHs using DATEV?
Yes. MYFUNDBOX is designed in Germany with European chart-of-accounts structures and DATEV-compatible export workflows [CONFIRM exact DATEV format].

### How long does onboarding take compared to NetSuite ARM?
Because MYFUNDBOX does not replace your core ERP or banking feeds, onboarding focuses solely on revenue data and accounting rules [ADD: typical onboarding weeks].

# MYFUNDBOX Finance & Revenue Accounting Blog

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/blog
- **Title**: Finance & Revenue Accounting Blog | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

Read concise, practitioner-written briefs on European recurring revenue accounting, GoBD audit readiness, DATEV journal workflows, and unifying RevOps metrics with statutory general ledgers.

## Why billing exports alone fail IFRS 15 and HGB audits

Billing exports capture invoice issuance and cash settlement—not the delivery of performance obligations over time. Closing books solely from Stripe or PSP CSVs leaves controllers reconciling credit notes, VAT rates, and multi-year prepayments manually.

- Separate cash collection dates from revenue start and end service dates.
- Isolate VAT liabilities across EU member states before calculating MRR.
- Lock historical periods to preserve audit integrity.

## Aligning German DATEV workflows with SaaS ARR reporting

German GmbHs frequently maintain statutory books in DATEV via an external Steuerberater while investors ask for real-time ARR waterfalls. A dedicated revenue sub-ledger bridges monthly Buchungsstapel journal exports with operational cohort analytics.

- Keep Steuerberater workflows consistent while automating PRAP deferred revenue schedules.
- Maintain a clear tie-out between monthly P&L revenue and board ARR decks.

# What is revenue management software?

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/guides/what-is-revenue-management-software
- **Title**: What Is Revenue Management Software? | MYFUNDBOX Guide
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

Revenue management software is a specialized financial sub-ledger that tracks, recognizes, forecasts, and reports earned revenue under standards like IFRS 15 and HGB. Unlike payment processors or billing tools, it sits between commercial systems and your general ledger to automate deferred revenue, accruals, and recurring revenue analytics.

## How does revenue management software differ from billing and payment tools?

Payment gateways move money, billing engines issue invoices, and general ledgers record statutory trial balances. Revenue management software translates complex contracts and invoices into compliant recognition schedules, KPIs, and forecasts.

| System Layer | Primary Job | Example Outputs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Payment Gateway | Collect cards, SEPA, wires | Settlement payouts, bank fees |
| Billing Engine | Generate customer invoices & dunning | PDF invoices, tax calculation, retries |
| Revenue Management (MYFUNDBOX) | Recognize, defer, forecast & analyze revenue | IFRS 15 waterfalls, PRAP schedules, ARR bridges, forecasts |
| Accounting / ERP (GL) | Statutory books, AP, payroll, tax filings | Trial balance, statutory P&L and balance sheet |

## Frequently Asked Questions

### When should a SaaS company adopt dedicated revenue management software?
Most teams adopt it once annual prepaid contracts, mid-term upgrades, multiple billing channels, or external audits make spreadsheet waterfalls error-prone.

### Does revenue management software replace our ERP or Steuerberater?
No. It acts as the specialized revenue sub-ledger feeding clean, summarized journal entries into your ERP or accounting package.

### What standards govern revenue management in Europe?
International and listed European groups typically follow IFRS 15 (issued by the IASB / IFRS Foundation), while local statutory entities follow national GAAP such as German HGB.

### Are MRR and recognized revenue the same thing?
No. MRR measures normalized recurring contract run-rate, while recognized revenue measures accounting revenue earned under IFRS 15/HGB during a calendar period.

### Can MYFUNDBOX manage both historical close and future forecasts?
Yes, uniting actual closed sub-ledger schedules with rolling renewal forecasts eliminates spreadsheet duplication.

---

# Revenue recognition for SaaS under IFRS 15

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/guides/revenue-recognition-saas-ifrs-15
- **Title**: Revenue Recognition for SaaS Under IFRS 15 | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

Under IFRS 15, SaaS providers recognize subscription revenue over time as the customer simultaneously receives and consumes access to the software. Upfront annual payments create a contract liability (deferred revenue), while distinct onboarding services, discounts, and contract modifications follow the IFRS Foundation five-step allocation framework.

## How do the 5 steps of IFRS 15 apply to a B2B SaaS contract?

Per the IFRS Foundation standard IFRS 15 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers), entities identify enforceable contracts, separate distinct obligations (such as SaaS access vs. custom setup), determine net transaction price excluding VAT, allocate based on standalone selling price, and recognize revenue as control transfers.

1. **Identify the contract with the customer**: Verify commercial substance, payment terms, and enforceable rights across signed order forms or self-serve terms.
2. **Identify separate performance obligations**: Evaluate whether implementation or training is distinct from the core SaaS subscription or bundled as one combined obligation.
3. **Determine the transaction price**: Exclude third-party collections such as EU VAT (USt/TVA) and account for variable consideration or volume rebates.
4. **Allocate transaction price via SSP**: Allocate bundled discounts proportionally based on standalone selling prices of each obligation.
5. **Recognize revenue over time or point-in-time**: Amortize continuous cloud access ratably across the subscription term.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Should SaaS onboarding fees be recognized upfront under IFRS 15?
Only if the onboarding service transfers a distinct good or service the customer could benefit from separately. Otherwise, non-refundable setup fees are often recognized over the expected customer benefit period.

### How does IFRS 15 treat EU VAT on SaaS invoices?
Amounts collected on behalf of tax authorities such as VAT are excluded from transaction price and recognized revenue.

### What happens when a customer upgrades mid-year?
Depending on whether additional seats are priced at standalone selling price, the change is accounted for either as a separate contract or a prospective modification.

### Is IFRS 15 identical to US GAAP ASC 606?
IFRS 15 and ASC 606 share a largely converged five-step model, though minor guidance differences exist around interim disclosures and specific contract cost rules.

### How does MYFUNDBOX verify IFRS 15 compliance?
MYFUNDBOX applies configurable performance-obligation rules consistently across every invoice and preserves an auditable tie-out to source contracts.

---

# How to calculate deferred revenue for subscription contracts

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/guides/how-to-calculate-deferred-revenue
- **Title**: How to Calculate Deferred Revenue (Formula & Example) | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

Deferred revenue equals upfront cash billed or collected for goods or services not yet delivered. Calculate ending deferred revenue using the roll-forward formula: Beginning Deferred Revenue + New Billings (net of VAT) − Recognized Revenue = Ending Deferred Revenue. Under IFRS 15 and HGB, it sits as a liability on the balance sheet.

## What is a worked EUR example of deferred revenue recognition?

Suppose a German B2B SaaS customer signs a €12.000 net annual subscription (plus 19% VAT = €14.280 gross) starting 1 January. VAT (€2.280) posts to VAT payable, €12.000 enters Deferred Revenue, and €1.000 is recognized to P&L revenue each month.

| Period | Beginning Deferred | Net Billed | Recognized Revenue | Ending Deferred |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Month 1 (Jan) | €0 | €12.000 | €1.000 | €11.000 |
| Month 2 (Feb) | €11.000 | €0 | €1.000 | €10.000 |
| Month 6 (Jun) | €7.000 | €0 | €1.000 | €6.000 |
| Month 12 (Dec) | €1.000 | €0 | €1.000 | €0 |

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is deferred revenue an asset or a liability?
Deferred revenue is a liability on the balance sheet because the company owes future software access or service delivery to the customer.

### Does VAT enter deferred revenue?
No. Statutory VAT is booked to a tax payable account, never into deferred or recognized revenue.

### What is the difference between deferred revenue and accrued revenue?
Deferred revenue arises when billing happens before delivery (liability). Accrued or unbilled revenue arises when delivery happens before billing (asset).

### Should annual prepayments be recognized daily or monthly?
Both are acceptable if applied consistently; daily exact-day proration is recommended when contracts start mid-month and vary materially across 28/30/31-day months.

### How can I model our portfolio deferred balance right now?
Use the interactive Deferred Revenue & Close-Time Estimator on the MYFUNDBOX Home page.

---

# MRR vs ARR vs recognized revenue: why finance teams track all three

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/guides/mrr-vs-arr-vs-recognized-revenue
- **Title**: MRR vs ARR vs Recognized Revenue Explained | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

MRR and ARR are non-GAAP operational run-rate metrics measuring active recurring subscription value at a point in time, whereas Recognized Revenue is the statutory accounting revenue earned during a period under IFRS 15 or HGB. Confusing run-rate metrics with P&L revenue causes board and audit discrepancies.

## How do Bookings, Billings, MRR, ARR, and Recognized Revenue differ?

Each metric captures a distinct moment in the customer lifecycle: signed commitment (Bookings), invoice issued (Billings), normalized run-rate (MRR/ARR), and statutory service delivery (Recognized Revenue).

| Metric | Type | Includes One-Time Fees? | Primary Audience |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bookings | Commercial commitment | Yes (total contract value) | Sales & Executive Leadership |
| Billings | Invoiced cash claim | Yes (plus VAT on invoice) | AR & Treasury |
| MRR / ARR | Operational recurring run-rate | No (recurring only, net of VAT) | CFO, RevOps & Investors |
| Recognized Revenue | Statutory P&L revenue (IFRS 15 / HGB) | Yes (when obligation satisfied) | Auditors, Tax Advisors & Statutory P&L |

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can ARR ever exceed annual recognized revenue?
Yes. In a fast-growing SaaS business, year-end ARR reflects December run-rate × 12, which is typically higher than trailing twelve-month recognized revenue.

### Why does a 28-day February affect daily recognized revenue but not MRR?
Standard MRR represents a normalized monthly run-rate, whereas exact-day accounting recognition allocates 28/365ths of an annual contract to February.

### Should discounts be netted out of MRR and ARR?
Yes, recurring contractual discounts reduce net MRR/ARR; temporary one-time credits should be disclosed clearly.

### How does MYFUNDBOX keep MRR and recognized revenue reconciled?
Both metrics compute from the same normalized contract and invoice sub-ledger, guaranteeing transparent reconciliation.

### Is VAT ever included in MRR or recognized revenue?
No. Both operational recurring metrics and statutory revenue must exclude statutory VAT.

---

# Revenue forecasting methods for subscription businesses

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/guides/revenue-forecasting-methods-subscription
- **Title**: Revenue Forecasting Methods for Subscription Businesses | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

Accurate subscription revenue forecasting combines three distinct layers: deterministic burn-down of existing deferred revenue backlog, cohort-based renewal and expansion modeling on active contracts, and probability-weighted new business from the CRM pipeline—projected separately for recognized P&L revenue and cash billings.

## Which forecasting method fits each time horizon?

Near-term quarter forecasts rely heavily on contracted deferred revenue burn-down, whereas 12–36 month strategic plans depend on cohort NRR assumptions and sales capacity.

1. **Layer 1: Contracted Backlog (0–12 months)**: Project guaranteed recognition already sitting in deferred revenue and non-cancellable contracts.
2. **Layer 2: Renewal & NRR Cohort Model (3–24 months)**: Apply segment-specific gross churn and expansion rates to upcoming renewal dates.
3. **Layer 3: Pipeline & New ARR Ramp (6–36 months)**: Layer weighted CRM opportunities and billing-mix assumptions (monthly vs. annual prepaid).

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Why do top-down ARR growth multipliers fail at audit or board level?
Flat percentage multipliers ignore renewal cliffs, annual billing seasonality, and the lag between new bookings and IFRS 15 revenue recognition.

### How does billing cadence affect recognized revenue vs. cash?
Switching customers from monthly to annual upfront billing accelerates cash collection immediately while recognized P&L revenue stays flat month-to-month.

### What retention rate should baseline models use?
Use trailing 4-quarter empirical segment GRR and NRR rather than aspirational targets for base-case financial plans.

### Does MYFUNDBOX separate committed backlog from modeled pipeline?
Yes, keeping deterministic backlog cleanly separated from assumption-driven upside.

### How often should forecasts be re-baselined?
Monthly after period close, saving each snapshot to measure actual variance.

# Revenue management, IFRS 15, and SaaS finance glossary

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/glossary
- **Title**: Revenue Management & IFRS 15 Glossary | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

A concise, audit-grounded glossary defining essential European recurring-revenue accounting and FP&A terms—from IFRS 15 performance obligations and German HGB Rechnungsabgrenzungsposten to MRR, ARR, NRR, and churn.

## Core accounting and SaaS revenue definitions

Standardized definitions prevent misalignment between Controllers, FP&A, RevOps, and external auditors when reporting recurring revenue across European entities.

| Term | Definition | Accounting / Metric Category |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Revenue Recognition | The accounting principle governing when earned revenue is recorded on the income statement as obligations are satisfied (IFRS 15 / HGB). | Statutory Accounting |
| Deferred Revenue | A balance sheet liability representing upfront billings or payments received before software/services are delivered (German: PRAP). | Balance Sheet Liability |
| Accrued (Unbilled) Revenue | A balance sheet asset recorded when services have been delivered before the customer invoice is issued (German: ARAP / unfertige Leistungen). | Balance Sheet Asset |
| Performance Obligation | A distinct promise in a customer contract to transfer a good or service under IFRS 15 Step 2. | IFRS 15 Framework |
| Standalone Selling Price (SSP) | The price at which an entity would sell a promised good or service separately, used to allocate bundled discounts. | IFRS 15 Allocation |
| MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) | Normalized monthly recurring contract value net of VAT and one-time fees. | SaaS Operational Metric |
| ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) | Annualized recurring revenue run-rate (MRR × 12) for active subscriptions at a measurement date. | SaaS Operational Metric |
| NRR (Net Revenue Retention) | Percentage of recurring revenue retained from an existing cohort after accounting for expansion, contraction, and churn. | Retention Cohort KPI |
| Revenue Churn | Recurring revenue lost from cancellations and downgrades over a measurement period. | Retention KPI |
| GoBD | German tax authority principles for orderly electronic bookkeeping, immutability, and digital audit traceability. | German Compliance |

# Security, GDPR compliance, and EU data residency

- **Canonical URL**: https://myfundbox.example/en/security
- **Title**: Security, GDPR & EU Compliance | MYFUNDBOX
- **Last Updated**: 2026-11-18

MYFUNDBOX is engineered for European regulatory expectations: EU data residency [CONFIRM: Frankfurt, Germany], signed GDPR Data Processing Agreements (DPA), granular role-based permissions, immutable audit logging, and strict zero-tracker defaults prior to cookie consent.

## How does MYFUNDBOX protect financial and personal data?

Financial sub-ledger data is isolated per tenant, encrypted in transit and at rest, and hosted within the European Union. Administrative, controller, and read-only auditor roles enforce least-privilege access across every workflow.

## Competitor Positioning Reference
Information about third-party software is compiled from publicly available documentation and vendor pages as of the review date shown. Features, pricing models, and compliance certifications may change; confirm current specifications directly with each vendor.

### MYFUNDBOX vs Zuora (Zuora Revenue)
Last reviewed: 2026-11-18

Zuora Revenue is an enterprise-grade revenue recognition engine built primarily for large global corporations running multi-product quote-to-cash ecosystems. MYFUNDBOX focuses on European finance teams that need IFRS 15, HGB/GoBD, and recurring revenue forecasting without multi-quarter enterprise ERP implementation cycles.

Angle: Purpose-built for EU mid-market and scaling finance teams seeking fast deployment, EU data residency, DATEV/EU ERP alignment, and transparent EUR reporting without enterprise suite bloat.

### MYFUNDBOX vs Chargebee RevRec
Last reviewed: 2026-11-18

Chargebee RevRec (formerly RevLock) is a revenue recognition product closely aligned with the Chargebee subscription billing ecosystem and US/global ASC 606 workflows. MYFUNDBOX is a standalone, billing-agnostic EU revenue management platform built in Germany for IFRS 15, HGB/GoBD accounting workflows, and integrated SaaS revenue forecasting.

Angle: Billing-agnostic EU revenue management uniting IFRS 15 recognition, recurring revenue metrics, forecasting, and European compliance in one GDPR-native platform.

### MYFUNDBOX vs Maxio
Last reviewed: 2026-11-18

Maxio (formed from Chargify and SaaSOptics) combines B2B subscription billing, SaaS metrics, and GAAP revenue recognition primarily for North American B2B SaaS companies. MYFUNDBOX focuses strictly on pure-play EU revenue management—delivering IFRS 15, HGB/GoBD alignment, and European data residency without bundling billing.

Angle: Pure EU revenue management built in Germany: get SaaS metrics, IFRS 15 recognition, and forecasting with EU data residency and without migrating off your billing tool.

### MYFUNDBOX vs Stripe Revenue Recognition
Last reviewed: 2026-11-18

Stripe Revenue Recognition automates accrual accounting and deferred revenue waterfalls directly for transactions processed inside the Stripe ecosystem. MYFUNDBOX is a standalone, payment-agnostic European revenue management platform that unifies revenue across Stripe, bank transfers, ERP invoices, and multiple billing tools while adding forecasting and EU compliance.

Angle: Ideal when your B2B revenue extends beyond Stripe card/checkout transactions into SEPA bank transfers, enterprise contracts, and EU ERP workflows.

### MYFUNDBOX vs NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM)
Last reviewed: 2026-11-18

NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) embeds IFRS 15 and ASC 606 revenue rules directly inside the Oracle NetSuite ERP environment. MYFUNDBOX gives European finance teams a faster, dedicated revenue management layer that works with any accounting/ERP system—including DATEV, Exact, Xero, SAP, or NetSuite—while adding modern SaaS KPIs and forecasting.

Angle: Get dedicated IFRS 15 revenue recognition, SaaS metrics, and forecasting in weeks—without migrating your entire general ledger to NetSuite.

### MYFUNDBOX vs Sage Intacct
Last reviewed: 2026-11-18

Sage Intacct is a full cloud financial management ERP popular in the US and UK that offers an add-on Contracts & Revenue Management module for ASC 606 and IFRS 15. MYFUNDBOX delivers dedicated EU-first revenue recognition, recurring revenue analytics, and forecasting as a lightweight layer over your existing continental European accounting stack.

Angle: Purpose-built for continental European and UK finance teams that want automated revenue recognition and SaaS forecasting without ripping out their core accounting system.

### MYFUNDBOX vs Vayu
Last reviewed: 2026-11-18

Vayu is a modern B2B revenue management and billing-automation platform focused heavily on complex usage-based pricing, contract-to-cash, and automated reconciliation. MYFUNDBOX differentiates as an EU-based, German-engineered revenue sub-ledger built explicitly around European compliance (IFRS 15, HGB/GoBD, EU VAT, GDPR residency) without functioning as a billing engine.

Angle: Pure revenue management built for EU finance controllers: strict separation from billing/payment execution, German HGB/GoBD and IFRS 15 rigor, and GDPR-first EU residency.

### MYFUNDBOX vs Billwerk+
Last reviewed: 2026-11-18

Billwerk+ is a European subscription management, recurring billing, and payment gateway platform built for automating checkout, invoicing, and dunning. MYFUNDBOX is not a billing engine or payment processor—it is specialized revenue management software for IFRS 15 revenue recognition, deferred revenue accruals, forecasting, and multi-source SaaS analytics.

Angle: Complementary or alternative depending on your need: keep Billwerk+ for billing if you like it, and add MYFUNDBOX for true IFRS 15 recognition, multi-source reconciliation, and revenue forecasting.
